name: Sprint board
description: Shows your team's current Azure DevOps sprint in a sidebar, flags board hygiene problems with a proposed fix for each, and lists who is working on what. Read-only.

mcpTools.name: board_check
mcpTools.description: Checks the team's current Azure DevOps sprint board read-only and returns the hygiene findings, each with a proposed fix, then who on the team is working on what and who is blocked with only lower-priority work left. Changes nothing.
